item.title: Blues Trade Rumors: Atlantic Team 'Actively Targeting' Justin Faulk
item.description: The St. Louis Blues continue to ask a high price for their multiple trade candidates, but that hasn't stopped teams from snooping around. item.title: LA Kings Are Ramping Up Their Push for Canucks' Star
item.description: The men's hockey event at the Olympics has been thrilling to this point, with Canada and the USA both surviving quarterfinal scares on Wednesday and advancing in overtime. But at least two NHL teams have not been enjoying the proceedings as much. item.title: Still A Path For Maple Leafs To Keep McMann
item.description: The Toronto Maple Leafs are not officially out of the playoff race as they're just six points back of the second wildcard spot. But, they have four teams to jump over to do so, and there are plenty of teams doing well in the East.The Maple Leafs' trade deadline approach is going to be an interesting one and may depend on how they come out of the break and how contract talks go with Bobby McMann. item.title: Devils Seeking Out Hockey Trade To Send Message
item.description: The New Jersey Devils have not had a good season and have played well below expectation with a 28-27-2 record. The team currently sits 15th in the Eastern Conference with 58 points and are 11 points back of a playoff spot. They have lost three in a row and five of the last six, scoring just two goals in the last three games and 10 goals in the last six. item.title: Canucks’ Filip Chytil Catches Another Awful Break
item.description: Here we go again.
